promises.quote: So whatever guidance this year, we have upgraded to grow by 25%, so we are still maintaining that we will grow more than 25%...
Now based on the strong demand in domestic and overseas markets, we are hopeful to grow in the current year by more than 25% and in next 3 to 4 years by 20% CAGR.
So our guidance is still maintaining that we will be growing at a 25%-plus growth rate and our EBITDA margin will be close to 11%.
